description: The disposable-cache decision is inverted: 'The cache is a source of truth for feeds'. The old pattern only caught 'cache is the source of truth'.

mutations.find: Feed pages are cached for speed only. The cache is not the source of truth; the metadata database stays it, so the cache can be flushed at any time.
mutations.replace: Feed pages are cached for speed. The cache is a source of truth for feeds, so it is never flushed.
